v2_origin.extracted_from: boundary-edges/index.js (Phase A: buildAdjacencyGraph + buildRidgeLines + class-filter pass), refactored into shared roof-graph.js per journal 2026-04-14-roof-graph-prepass-boundary-3d. v3 splits this off from v2's monolithic boundary-signals step as the first sub-step of the boundary-signals decomposition (audit 2026-05-11).

summary: First sub-step of the split bench-v2 boundary-signals (Phase A + class filter). Produces the topology skeleton — PLANES, RIDGES, RIDGE_LINES — that v7-boundary-signals then enriches with corners, nearby projections, and per-plane signal grids. Adjacency graph counts cross-plane kNN contacts; per surviving pair, the two grm-seed-plane equations are intersected, group points projected for tMin/tMax extents, weak overlap and sparse contacts filtered, edge type classified (ridge/hip/valley/step/flashing), and side-sign sampled for the wrong-side filter downstream. Then a class filter rejects planes whose ground/veg/water fraction exceeds threshold, with a ridge-neighbour rescue.

phases.name: Adjacency graph
phases.description: kNN-radius search around every owner-assigned point; for each cross-group neighbour, increment a (lo,hi)→count hash entry. Pairs with count < min_contact_pts are dropped. Hash key is (a<<32)|b with sentinel 0 reserved.

phases.name: Plane-pair intersection
phases.description: For each surviving adj pair, solve the two grm-seed-plane equations for their line of intersection via Cramer's rule (det3 < 1e-12 → reject as parallel/degenerate). NOTE: v3 trusts the post-GRM plane equations as authoritative — no re-fit from owner points (one revert lineage 1a62e94 → 54fd8da explored the re-fit path and abandoned it per audit policy 'minimize duplication').

phases.name: Per-side extent projection + overlap/sparsity filters
phases.description: Each group's points project onto the line for tMinA/tMaxA, tMinB/tMaxB. Reject if clip length ≤ 0, overlap ratio < 0.15, or contacts/m below 30% of expected sqrt(sqrt(n)) when clip_len > spacing*3.

phases.name: Edge-type classify
phases.description: Angle between normals + line-direction up-axis component decide: <10° → flashing (4); line near horizontal + both normals up → ridge (1); line near horizontal + mixed → step (5); >60° → hip (2) if avg up > 0.3 else valley (3); else ridge. up_axis param swaps y/z (v2 y-up vs v3 z-up LAZ).

phases.name: Ridge-elevation trim
phases.description: For non-horizontal ridges (|line_dir.up| > 0.03), clamp tMinA/tMaxA/tMinB/tMaxB to the t-values where the ridge crosses the per-group min/max up-axis extents. Prevents ridges from extending above/below either group's actual point range.

phases.name: Side-sign sampling
phases.description: side_vec = cross(line_dir, normalA), normalized. For each group, average side_vec·(p−line_point) over points within spacing*3 perpendicular distance of the ridge — sign of mean → side_sign ∈ {−1, 0, +1}. The has_side flag is set iff |side_vec| > 1e-12 (degenerate is rare; happens when line_dir ∥ normalA). Powers boundary-corners D.2b wrong-side filter.

phases.name: Class filter (gvw rejection + ridge-neighbour rescue)
phases.description: Per plane: compute group classification counts (building/ground/lowVeg/medVeg/highVeg/water/other). Candidate-reject if (ground+veg+water)/total > classFilterThreshold. Then for each candidate-rejected plane, rescue if it is ridge-adjacent to any plane that is NOT candidate-rejected. Tombstoned (from GRM merge) and low-nPts (< min_plane_pts) planes get separate rejection reasons (4 and 3) and are not eligible for rescue. Skipped when classifications artifact is absent.

phases.name: Basis derivation
phases.description: For every plane, compute an orthonormal in-plane basis (e1, e2) from the seed normal (fallback to standard axes if cross product degenerates). Used by viz + downstream 2D projections.

parameters.name: adjacencyRadius
parameters.summary: kNN-radius for counting cross-plane contacts in A.1.
parameters.rationale: Larger radius captures shared boundary regions more robustly; too large pollutes contact counts with bulk neighbours from the same plane. 0.5 m is a v2-inherited value tuned for ~10 pts/m² density.

parameters.name: minContactPts
parameters.summary: Minimum cross-plane contact count to keep an adjacency pair.
parameters.rationale: Filters spurious adjacencies from isolated point pairs. 3 is the smallest integer threshold that resists single-point noise without dropping legitimate short ridges.

parameters.name: classFilterThreshold
parameters.summary: Plane is candidate-rejected if (ground+lowVeg+medVeg+highVeg+water)/total exceeds this fraction.
parameters.rationale: Building class (6) should dominate roof planes. At >50% non-building classification, the seed plane likely lives in a tree/ground region misassigned to a roof group; ridge-neighbour rescue protects legitimate eaves that happen to brush ground points.

parameters.name: minPlanePts
parameters.summary: Planes with fewer owner-assigned points are auto-rejected (reason 3).
parameters.rationale: Plane fit + adjacency are unreliable below ~6 pts. Matches v2 boundary-signals/Phase A behaviour.

parameters.name: upAxis
parameters.summary: World up-axis index: 1 = y-up (v2 bench), 2 = z-up (v3 prod LAZ).
parameters.rationale: Edge-type classification ('upness' of line + normals) and ridge-elevation trim are axis-aware. v3 prod defaults to 2 (LAZ z-up); bench harnesses leave the default at 1 for v2 byte-parity.

parameters.name: spacing
parameters.summary: Average point spacing — used for sparse-contact gate and side-sample distance (spacing*3).
parameters.rationale: Sentinel −1 means 'read per-bldg from bldg-thresholds' (v7-derive-thresholds is single source of truth, see commit 4ac68ab). Pipeline params can override. Hardcoded 0.316 = sqrt(1/10) is the v2 fallback when lidar-density artifact is missing; used by bench harnesses that bypass parse_params. On dahouet the actual per-bldg spacing is 0.224 (density 19.87) — the hardcoded fallback under-samples by 41%.

reads.name: building-local-frames
reads.description: Per-building (cx,cy,cz) centroid + axes. Centroid is subtracted to reproduce the centroid-shifted F32-cast frame the kd-tree was built in (build-building-kd-trees.c convention).

reads.name: building-kd-trees
reads.description: Per-building serialized kd-tree over building-local positions.

reads.name: grm-owner
reads.description: Per-building Int16 owner array; -1 = unassigned. K is implicit from grm-seed-planes record count.

reads.name: grm-seed-planes
reads.description: Per-building ARRAY_INLINE of authoritative post-merge plane equations (normal, d, tombstoned). 72-byte header; only normal/d/tombstoned are read.

reads.name: bldg-thresholds
reads.description: Per-building derived thresholds (density, spacing, z_noise, dist_threshold_seed/grm). Spacing is sourced from this single artifact unless the pipeline overrides via params.

reads.name: lidar-classifications
reads.description: Tile-wide U8 per-point ASPRS class. Optional — when absent, A.3 class filter is skipped and rejection_reason 1 is never emitted.

writes.name: boundary-topology-roof-graph
writes.description: Per-building ARRAY_INLINE of TLV blobs. Each TLV holds PLANES, RIDGES, RIDGE_LINES sections per ROOF-GRAPH-FORMAT.md §4.1/4.2/4.3. Coordinates are tile-world (post-shift back from building-local compute frame).

v3_divergences.rationale: v2 boundary-signals.js did Phase A (topology) + Phase B (signal grids) + Phase C (anchors) in one step. v3 splits these into v7-boundary-topology + v7-boundary-signals so each artifact has a single owner and the wire format (roof-graph TLV) is built incrementally.

Dropped curvatures-k32, linearity (reserved-only params in v2 ridges.js — never read), boundary-candidates/-all and ridge-candidates (destructured but never referenced), point-weights for plane fit (we trust grm-seed-planes equations; no re-fit per audit 'minimize duplication'), and the tile-wide kd-tree (v3 uses per-bldg building-kd-trees). See impl.h header comment.

v3_divergences.topic: Building-local compute frame with tile-world output
v3_divergences.rationale: Compute runs in centroid-shifted F32-roundtrip space (kd-tree convention from build-building-kd-trees.c). After v7_topo_compute returns, wrapper post-processes outputs: positional fields (centroid, ridge from/to, line_point) get (cx,cy,cz) added; direction vectors are translation-invariant; plane d shifted by −n·c. Without this, viz subtracts scene origin from local coords and geometry projects far off-screen.

v3_divergences.topic: Spacing sourced from per-building thresholds artifact
v3_divergences.rationale: v2 used tile-wide lidar-density (or 0.316 fallback); v3 prod has reduced per-bldg working sets so density needs to be per-bldg. The derive-thresholds step is now the single source of truth — topology reads spacing from bldg-thresholds unless pipeline params explicitly override.

v3_divergences.topic: has_side flag bit added to RIDGE_LINES (wire format extension)
v3_divergences.rationale: v3 originally only set flag bit 0x01 (has_line). boundary-corners D.2b reader gates the wrong-side filter on bit 0x02 (has_side); the bit was never set, so the filter silently skipped every ridge and let all wrong-side convex anchors through (dahouet 7-shared-edges bug). Fix: add bool has_side to v7_topo_ridge_line_t (= sv_len > 1e-12), emit bit 0x02 in pack_ridge_lines_section. v2 has no equivalent bit because the side test there reads a separate JS object field, not a packed flag.

1a62e94 added a least-squares re-fit of plane equations from owner-points before intersection (rationale: tighten geometric error of post-GRM equations). Reverted in 54fd8da — re-fit introduced drift vs v2 byte-parity and the audit explicitly forbids duplicate plane fitting. Kept here as historical context.

open_questions: Should plane equations be re-fit from owner points before ridge intersection? Explored in 1a62e94, reverted in 54fd8da. Audit policy currently says no; re-evaluate once GRM is stable on the full bench corpus.

Sparse-contact filter uses contacts_per_m < expected_cpm * 0.3 and clip_len > spacing*3 — both gates are required (logical AND). Is this the right combination, or should they be independent? Untested on the bench corpus.

Ridge-neighbour class-filter rescue (A.3) only checks immediate ridge neighbours, not transitive ones (one-hop, no propagation). Mirrors v2 but may under-rescue chains of borderline-gvw planes connected only through other borderline planes.
